Instigating(प्रेरक).
--2 Destroying the enemies.
--3 A
lord, master.
--4 Active,
powerful, an epithet of Pūṣan and of
the Aśvins.

ईर्य a. To be excited.
--र्या
Wandering about as a religious
mendicant.
--Comp.
--पथः {1} the
observances of a religious mendicant to
obtain knowledge. {2} the four
positions of the body, i. e. going,
standing upright, sitting, and lying
down.
